summary: The DGA Gregorian date field: a native date input whose value is ISO text (yyyy-mm-dd, or '' when empty), with min/max and today rules from a caller-supplied today. A signal-model control: bind [(value)] or a signal-forms field.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The date as yyyy-mm-dd, or '' when empty or unreadable; two-way [(value)].

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label (translated).

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the input invalid.

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Today as yyyy-mm-dd from the caller's clock (dgaTodayIso); the component never reads the clock.

inputs.name: notAfterToday
inputs.description: Caps the max at today (needs today).

inputs.name: notBeforeToday
inputs.description: Raises the min to today (needs today).

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Native required plus a decorative asterisk.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the input invalid without a message.

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The new ISO date (or '') on every input (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true on the first blur.

outputs.name: issueChange
outputs.description: The field's own problem when it changes: 'unreadable' (half-typed), 'before-min', 'after-max', or null.

a11y: Native date input: the browser supplies the segment keyboard model, the calendar popup and the screen-reader announcements in the page language. The label is linked with for/id, hint and error with aria-describedby; an error, invalid or an own issue sets aria-invalid. The required asterisk is aria-hidden. Logical CSS mirrors the control in RTL; the browser orders the date segments by its own locale.
